title: GitLab connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [GitLab connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/gitlab) is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

Use the connector to ingest repository, project, group, CI/CD, and security data from GitLab into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth U2M authentication and supports incremental ingestion, UI-based pipeline authoring, Declarative Automation Bundles, and API-based pipeline authoring.
